retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s soul aesthetic featuring a central trio portrait with a cyan-tinted outer glow and heavy, blocky display typography with deep perspective shadows.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait of three figures with large afro hairstyles, surrounded by a soft cyan-blue ethereal glow, topped by massive, yellow-filled block lettering with an exaggerated black 3D drop shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central figure flanked by two secondary figures in a triangular formation
Heavy top-weighted typography balancing the dark figures below
Cyan outer glow contrasting with warm skin tones and dark clothing
Arched secondary text following the curve of the central afro
coreInvariants: Heavy black 3D perspective shadow on the main title
Cyan-blue atmospheric glow around the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, with the central figure being the largest and most forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the massive top-aligned title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold top title, down to the central face, then outward to the flanking figures and the arched subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Light blue-grey background with a soft cyan vignette around the subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in hair and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow fill in the primary display type
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with low value, high-texture subjects; saturated yellow for the title.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif or heavy grotesque
letterConstructionRules: Massive black 3D extrusion extending downwards and to the right
Yellow fill with thin black outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are compressed to touch or overlap slightly
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display type paired with a light, arched sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for the main title.
Suitable for the arched secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of three people with large afros in a triangular layout, with a soft cyan-blue glow emanating from behind them against a light grey background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large yellow title at the top with a massive black 3D drop shadow, and a smaller arched subtitle following the curve of the central figure's hair.

verificationChecks: Is the title shadow deep and solid black?
Is there a cyan glow around the figures?
Are the figures arranged in a trio?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D shadow is not blurred.
Ensure the cyan glow doesn't overpower the faces.
Verify the yellow title is the most prominent element.
Confirm the triangular composition of the subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: 70s Soul Trio + Cyan Halo + Heavy 3D Block Type
